predecessors.name: Ife Empire
predecessors.text: the Oyo-Ile area founded by Oranmiyan

successors.name: Ilorin Emirate
successors.text: the north of Oyo, which Ilorin took: Ilorin 'attacked and burned down Oyo-Ile'

successors.name: Ibadan Republic
successors.text: Ibadan, 'settled as a war camp by Oyo commanders in 1830'

successors.name: Egba United Government
successors.text: the Egba country, whose people 'massacred the Ilari stationed among them' (undated)

successors.name: New Oyo
successors.text: south of Oyo-Ile: 'the Oyo royal family fled southward to establish a new capital at Oyo Atiba (New Oyo)' (Old Oyo page); 'the capital moved south to Ago d'Oyo' (Oyo page)

ledger.x: c. 1300: Oranmiyan founds Oyo at Oyo-Ile. 'The founding is dated to 1300' but 'only an estimate from working backward through the chronology' (Oyo page); 'Settled: 14th century, founder Oranmiyan' (Old Oyo page); infobox predecessor Ife Empire.
c. 1535: the Nupe occupy Oyo. 'Around 1535, the Nupe occupied Oyo and forced the ruling dynasty into exile in Borgu, then sacked the capital.'
c. 1535: the court goes into exile; the infobox gives Oyo-Igboho as capital c. 1535-1615 (Ofinran later 'had a new capital, Oyo-Igboho, built').
c. 1615: the capital returns from Igboho to Oyo-Ile (infobox 'Oyo-Ile (c. 1615-1835)').
17th century: Oyo grows westward and southward.
1734: the shape reaches the Benin side.
1748: the long war ends in Dahomey's subjugation.
1748: Dahomey becomes a tributary of Oyo.
1752: the shape reaches the Togo side to 0.98 E.
1769: the shape reaches the Volta coast at 0.11 E and 5.75 N.
1823: Dahomey defeats Oyo and ends the tribute.
1835: Ilorin destroys Oyo-Ile and the empire ends.

wars.name: Nupe conquest of Oyo
wars.outcome: The Nupe occupied Oyo about 1535, sacked the capital and drove the dynasty into exile in Borgu; Ofinran regained the land after about 80 years.

wars.name: Oyo-Dahomey wars
wars.outcome: Oyo won the four-day battle of 1728 and subjugated Dahomey in 1748 after 11 invasions; Dahomey paid tribute until 1823.

wars.name: Battle of Atakpame
wars.outcome: 'An Akyem-Dahomey-Oyo force defeated an Ashanti army'; no territory recorded.

wars.name: Oyo campaigns against Borgu and Nupe
wars.outcome: Both campaigns, in 1783 and 1789, failed; no territory moved.

wars.name: Blockade of Badagry
wars.outcome: An Oyo-Dahomey-Lagos force blockaded Badagri; no territory moved.

wars.name: Ilorin secession and the Fulani war
wars.outcome: Afonja refused Awole's order in 1793, forced Awole's suicide in 1795 and seceded Ilorin in 1817; Afonja was killed in 1823 and Ilorin joined the Sokoto Caliphate; Ilorin destroyed Oyo-Ile in 1835.

wars.name: Dahomean war of independence from Oyo
wars.outcome: Dahomey, led by Ghezo (accession 1818), defeated Oyo and ended its tribute; the Dahomey page's body text puts the decisive battle at Paonignan in 1827.
